title: Pentaho BI Developer - CTools Practitioner
description: Hands-on workshop for the dashboard BI Developer. Build interactive Pentaho Community Tools (CTools) dashboards in the Pentaho User Console — Community Data Access (CDA), the Community Dashboard Framework (CDF), the Community Dashboard Editor (CDE) with CCC charts, and the Community Graphics Generator (CGG).

assistant.subject: Pentaho CTools dashboards (CDE, CDF, CDA and CCC charts)
suggestions: What do CDA, CDF and CDE each do?
How do I connect a CDA data source to my dashboard?
How do I add a CCC chart component in CDE?
How do I make dashboard components react to a parameter?

moduleSummaries.title: Getting Started
moduleSummaries.summary: Meet the CTools stack — CDA, CDF, CDE, CCC, and CGG — installed on top of the Pentaho Server. Enable the CDE/CDA plugins, then build your first dashboard to see how the pieces fit together.

moduleSummaries.title: Community Data Access
moduleSummaries.summary: CDA is the data layer for CTools dashboards: a single abstraction over many sources with parameter-driven queries, joins/unions, preview, and exports. Create CDA data sources and feed them to dashboard components.

moduleSummaries.title: Community Dashboard Framework
moduleSummaries.summary: CDF is the code-first dashboard framework — HTML/CSS/JavaScript with managed component and dashboard lifecycles. Understand the framework that CDE is built on by assembling CDF dashboards directly.

moduleSummaries.title: Community Dashboard Editor
moduleSummaries.summary: CDE is the graphical dashboard editor: a Layout / Components / Data Sources workflow over the CDF framework. Build the Carrier Dashboard with responsive Bootstrap layouts, CCC charts, parameters, and selectors — no hand-coding required.

moduleSummaries.title: Community Graphics Generator
moduleSummaries.summary: CGG renders CCC charts server-side as images — for reports, for browsers with limited SVG support, and via URL. Generate the Carrier Dashboard's charts with CGG.

moduleSummaries.title: Use Cases
moduleSummaries.summary: Put it together end-to-end: build a complete Retail Sales analysis dashboard that combines CDA data sources, CDE layout and components, and CCC charts.
